Remarks
(Any outstanding or peculiar feature to be commented on by investigating officer).

At 7.24 p.m. 11-7-58, a telephone message was received from C.I.C. 2156 who stated he had heard an explosion which he surmised was a bomb at the rear of the C.M.A. Building, Bubbling Well Road.
Inspt. i/c, D.S.P. Read, Sgts. Ching Poh Fung and C.D.C. 19 immediately attended when it was found that a hand grenade had been thrown in Lane 161 Burkill Road exploding outside the Tah Ting Yang Printing Shop (No. 1). No casualties and only slight damage to paving and few windows of Chinese houses cracked and broken.

Scene The Tah Ting Yang Printing Shop is situated as the last house in an cul-de-sac sub alleyway of Lane 161 Burkill Road, entrance from Burkill Road. The end wall which creates the cul-de-sac of this sub alleyway is also a common wall, to Lane 70 Bubbling Well Road (Foo Yuen Li) and which extends from Bubbling Well Road through to Burkill Road.

The printing shop itself is well inside the premises and the object in throwing the bomb would not appear to be to inflict damage but merely an act of intimidation.

The door of the printing shop was closed and is of the large stout type which first gives access to a small courtyard.

Search in the vicinity was made and the following found
1. Piece of wood from the grenade handle.
2. Small piece of iron bomb casing.
3. Brass screw fitting (this may or may not be part of the grenade).

1938年3月11日晚上7:24，接到中央电话局2156号电话留言，称听到爆炸声，推测是南京路（Bubbling Well Road）中央市场大楼（C.M.A. Building）后方有炸弹。
负责督察、DSP Read巡官、Ching Poh Fung警长及CDC 19立即赶赴现场，发现一枚手榴弹被投掷在伯基尔路（Burkill Road）161弄内，在大定洋印刷所（Tah Ting Yang Printing Shop）（1号）外爆炸。无人伤亡，仅路面轻微受损，几户华人房屋的窗户震裂破碎。

现场 大定洋印刷所位于伯基尔路161弄一条死胡同支弄的最后一栋房屋，入口来自伯基尔路。构成该支弄死胡同的端墙也是一堵共用墙，通向南京路70弄（福源里），该墙从南京路延伸至伯基尔路。

印刷所本身位于院内深处，投掷炸弹的目的似乎并非造成破坏，而仅仅是恐吓行为。

印刷所的门紧闭，属于厚重的大型门，首先进入一个小庭院。

对附近进行了搜查，发现以下物品：
1. 手榴弹柄的一块木头。
2. 一小块铁制炸弹外壳。
3. 黄铜螺丝配件（这可能是也可能不是手榴弹的一部分）。

It would appear that the grenade had been thrown

Extensive enquiry in the vicinity failed to find anyone
who had witnessed more than the hearing of the explosion.
Search was also made for the 'string & pin' the pulling
of which, discharges this type of grenade, but same could
not be found.

Enquiry at the printing shop revealed that the manager
Tsang Ping Vung (張炳文) left Shanghai in April 1937 for
Honan and owing to hostilities, has not returned since.
He wrote to Shanghai shortly after hostilities commenced
and told the staff to close down, but as this would have
entailed the loss of employment to all (about 50) they
decided, in the master's continued absence, to carry on
for their own benefit. These are the conditions under
which the printing shop is at present working.

The broker for this printing shop is one Zee S Foh
(徐賜富) and he, when questioned re the work done in the
shop, stated he had recently taken printing orders from
the Police Bureau of Shanghai City Ta Tao Government.

He stated that about two weeks ago a Chinese named

看来手榴弹是从相邻的小巷（南京路70弄）越过墙壁投掷过来的，如果是这种情况，投掷者在投掷炸弹前无法看到现场情况。然而，投掷者可以轻易逃往伯基尔路或南京路。
在附近进行了广泛查询，未能找到任何目击者，仅有人听到爆炸声。
还搜寻了拉动即可引爆此类手榴弹的“拉绳及插销”，但未找到。

对印刷所的查询显示，经理张炳文（Tsang Ping Vung）于1937年4月离开上海前往河南，由于战事，此后一直未归。
他在战事开始后不久写信给上海，指示员工停业，但这将导致所有人（约50人）失业，因此他们决定在老板持续缺席的情况下，为了自身利益继续经营。这就是该印刷所目前的经营状况。

该印刷所的掮客是徐赐富（Zee S Foh），当被问及店内所做工作时，他表示最近承接了上海市政府大道政府警察局的印刷订单。

“Dai”的日本人（姓名不详）来到他的店里，要求印制100张名片，并商定价格为1.00美元，声称两天后回来提供详细信息。两天后，“Dai”独自返回，出示了一份住户登记样本，建议下达10,000份的订单。三天后，徐赐富将校样送至浦东捕房，就在那时，“Dai”在抬头填上“上海市政府大道政府警察局”，并以每1,000份5.60美元的价格订购了50,000份。两三天后，Dai派一名男孩到印刷所取货，徐赐富前往浦东捕房收取了款项。

居住于吴福龙54号。
常州 // C.D.S. 149
老闸捕房 1938年3月16日。

1938年3月16日中午12点左右，我奉店主之命
送一些食物到江西路的Two Company。返回时
约下午1点，当接近吴福龙附近的南京路时，
我听到一声爆炸响，随后我看到路上冒起一股
浓烟。我还看到一辆载有日本士兵的摩托卡车
由东向西行驶，另一辆载有英国士兵的卡车向
相反方向行驶。当时车辆和行人交通都很繁忙。
两辆载有士兵的摩托卡车均未停下，我也未看
到任何人以逃跑的方式离开。

以上是我的真实陈述。

警长 周洪生。

REPORT

Subject Hand Grenade thrown by some unknown person in Lane 379
Foochow Road.

Made by D.S.I. Smith Forwarded by [Signature]

Sir,

At 7.52 a.m. 19-3-38, a telephone message was received
from C.P.W.1440 named Sung Yoeh Poo (沈月波) to the effect
that a hand grenade had been thrown in Lane 379 Foochow Rd.

A party of Police Officers headed by C.D.I. Sharman
immediately proceeded to Lane 379 Foochow Road and ascertained
that at about 7.35 a.m. 19-3-38, a hand grenade had been
thrown in a subsidiary alleyway of Lane 379 Foochow Road
which is a cul-de-sac abutted by the rear walls of the
Kiangsu (江苏) Lodging House on the South and the Chi Shin
(啟新) Lodging House on the North. The hand grenade exploded
in the concrete gutter immediately beneath a ground floor
bath room window of the Kiangsu Lodging House about 5 yards
from the rear door to the premises. The result of the
explosion caused a cavity in the gutter about 9" diameter
and 6" deep. The fragments from the exploded grenade spattered
the wall of the Chi Shin Lodging House and broke 5 panes of
glass in the 1st floor window of room No.39 and 3 panes of
glass in the 1st floor window of room No.38, which are
situated 16 feet above the ground level. A female occupant
of Room No.38 of the Chi Shin Lodging House named Poo Tsai
Woo (浦彩娥), age 19 years, native of Zangzoh, was struck on
the right ankle by a splinter of glass. She suffered from
a slight abrasion and refused to attend hospital.

A fragment of the missile passed through the closed front
door window of the Wong Yoong Shing (王永興) Tailors Shop,
House 19, Lane 379 Foochow Road, which is situated immediately
opposite the alleyway into which the hand grenade was thrown,
and struck a tailor named Ayung Ping Kung (金炳根) age 29 yrs.

（左侧印章：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / SPECIAL BRANCH / 21 MAR. 1938）

事由：不明人士在福州路379弄投掷手榴弹。

由 侦探长史密斯（D.S.I. Smith）呈报 转呈 [签名]

先生，

1938年3月19日上午7时52分，接获编号为C.P.W.1440的巡捕沈月波（Sung Yoeh Poo）电话报告，称福州路379弄内有人投掷了一枚手榴弹。

由首席侦探督察夏曼（C.D.I. Sharman）率领的一队警员立即前往福州路379弄，经查实，约于1938年3月19日上午7时35分，一枚手榴弹被投掷进福州路379弄的一条支弄内，该支弄为死胡同，南面紧靠江苏旅社（Kiangsu Lodging House）的后墙，北面紧靠啟新旅社（Chi Shin Lodging House）的后墙。手榴弹在江苏旅社一楼浴室窗户正下方的混凝土排水沟内爆炸，距离该处后门约5码。爆炸结果在排水沟内造成一个直径约9英寸、深6英寸的坑洞。爆炸产生的碎片溅射到啟新旅社的墙壁上，并震碎了位于离地面16英尺高的二楼39号房间的5块玻璃窗以及38号房间的3块玻璃窗。啟新旅社38号房间的一名女住客浦彩娥（Poo Tsai Woo），19岁，籍贯Zangzoh（音译），右脚踝被玻璃碎片击中。她受轻微擦伤，拒绝前往医院治疗。

一枚弹片穿过位于福州路379弄19号、正对手榴弹投掷所在支弄的王永興（Wong Yoong Shing）裁缝店关闭的前门玻璃窗，击中了一名站在入口内侧的金炳根（Ayung Ping Kung，音译），29岁。

（左侧印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 特务处 / 1938年3月21日）

The fragment tore through his clothing on the right arm about
6" below the shoulder and ricocheted into a wooden partition
at the rear of the shop which is 40 yards from the point where
the grenade exploded.

Kyung Ping Kung was taken to the Lester Chinese Hospital
by his employer named Wong Yoong Pao (王永保) and the following
doctor's certificate was issued:-

    "Abrasion of right arm. Not serious.
     Requiring about 4 days' treatment in
     the O.P. Dept."

A brass disc and three fragments of a hand grenade were
found in close proximity of the explosion. They were submitted
to the Arms Identification Section for examination and it was
learned that they are parts of a German type hand grenade
that explodes upon impact.

Extensive enquiries were conducted in Lane 379 Foochow
Road and adjacent alleyways which lead into Canton Road on the
South and Shantung Road on the East, but no persons were located
who saw the hand grenade thrown, or who observed any person/s
running away. A number of persons including the injured man
heard the explosion but no further information could be obtained
from them.

The managements of the Kiangsu and the Chi Shin Lodging
Houses were questioned but they could not put forward any
reasons for the grenade being thrown. No evidence was gleaned
to suggest that their establishments are being used for
procuring prostitutes for the Japanese Military.

No persons residing in the vicinity of Lane 379 Foochow Rd.
have been the recipients of threatening letters.

金炳功（Kyung Ping Kung，音译）由其雇主王永保（Wong Yoong Pao）送往莱斯中国医院（Lester Chinese Hospital），并出具了以下医生证明：

    “右臂擦伤。不严重。
     需在门诊部治疗约4天。”

在爆炸附近发现了一个黄铜圆盘和三块手榴弹碎片。这些物品已提交给武器鉴定科进行检查，获悉它们是德式撞击引爆手榴弹的部件。

在福州路379弄及向南通往广东路、向东通往山东路的相邻支弄中进行了广泛调查，但未找到目击手榴弹被投掷或看到有人逃跑的人员。包括受伤男子在内的多人听到了爆炸声，但未能从他们那里获得更多信息。

江苏旅社和啟新旅社的管理层接受了问询，但他们无法提出手榴弹被投掷的任何理由。未收集到任何证据表明其场所被用于为日军招募妓女。

居住在福州路379弄附近的人士均未收到恐吓信。

It would appear that the hand grenade was discarded
by a person who wished to rid himself of same and who may
have gone into Lane 379 Foochow Road after having observed
a Walking Search Party that was operating at 7.35a.m. on
Foochow Road near Fokien Road about 200 yards West of Lane
379 Foochow Road.

The nearest police officers to the scene of the explosion
were C.D.C.37 and C.P.C.2056 on duty at the Standard Newspaper
No.436 Foochow Road, and C.P.C.2288 walking 5 Beat 2 Sect.
These officers were about 100 yards from Lane 379 Foochow Rd.
and 190 yards from the scene of the explosion. They heard a
loud report at about 7.35a.m. but did not know from what
direction it came. Several minutes later a ricsha coolie
came from the direction of Fokien Road and informed them
that a number of packing cases had fallen in an alleyway off
Fokien Road.

The Reserve Unit was in attendance.

Major K.M. Bourne, Deputy Commissioner Special Branch
and Mr. H. Robertson, D.C."A" attended the scene of the
explosion.

Statement from injured man attached.

attended, closing the New World Amusement Resort and

1938年3月25日下午6时50分，通过（无编号）街头电话亭（南京路与浙江路）从 C.P.C.100 收到电话消息，称有不明身份者投掷炸弹，在南京路爆炸。

一队警员立即赶赴现场，由总督察谢尔斯韦尔（Shellswell）率领，抵达后查明以下情况：-

1938年3月25日下午6时45分许，当时南京路上双向（即由东向西及由西向东）车流繁忙，显然有两枚炸弹由不明身份者投掷，其中一枚在南京路南侧爆炸，位置大约在东行电车轨道上、距南侧人行道以北约三码处，以及湖北路、浙江路与南京路交叉口以东约三十码处。无人受伤，亦无财产损失。

从已爆炸炸弹上拾获的碎片，连同从南京路591号老九纶丝织公司（Lao Kiu Luen Silk Company）店面入口以西约两码的人行道上拾获的一枚未爆炸弹，一并收集。

这些碎片连同那枚显然是香烟铁盒类型的未爆炸弹，被放入一桶水中并带至本巡捕房。它们将于1938年3月26日上午送往汉口路工部局公共卫生处化学科的弗莱彻先生（Mr. Fletcher）处，以征求其意见。

路面上留有彩色粉末痕迹，推测为炸弹铁盒内所装某种爆炸物质所致。

My name is Zau Yue Foong, age 55, native of Ningpo, married assistant manager, employed at the Lao Kiu Luen Silk Company, 591, Nanking Road.

Before the present hostilities our shop had been dealing in Japanese made goods on consignment basis, but since the outbreak of the said hostilities on the 13-8-37 we have stopped dealing in this class of goods, and nor have we received any letter of a threatening nature.

At 6.45 p.m. today (25-3-38) whilst I was in the shop, I heard an explosion outside. At that time I felt frightened and about three minutes later I went out of the shop where I observed a cigarette tin lying on the pavement and the foreign and Chinese detectives were conducting investigation there. I know nothing further.

The above is my true statement.

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.

Bomb Explosion in Italian Consulate Grounds.

In accordance with the instructions of the D.D.O. "A" Division, the undersigned interviewed the U.S. Marine Intelligence Officer and Officer in charge of the U.S. Marines, conducting observation patrols, at the Yu Ya Ching Road and Bubbling Well Road intersection, and the Bubbling Well Road and Hart Road intersection, in efforts to check the times of Japanese Motor Trucks and/or cars passing the above points prior to, and after, the throwing of the bomb into the Italian Consulate Grounds.

On the 15/4/38 this information was promised, and upon the 20/4/38 it was ascertained that only one motor truck travelling west, had passed the Yu Ya Ching Road point, but this at approximately one half hour prior to the occurrence taking place.

Several motor cars had passed in both directions, but the time did not correspond to any great degree of accuracy, and it is improbable that the bomb would be thrown from a motor car, due to the distance and place of explosion.

No further details or information were obtained during the interview.

bomb had been thrown over the wall on the south side

Savoia Grenadiers conducted a systematic and lengthy

water flask but the other piece could not be identified

At 6 a.m. on the 30-3-38, the undersigned proceeded
to the grounds of the Italian Consulate and conducted
a further search, which resulted in locating the place
where the bomb have struck, on the pathway of the old
entrance onto Bubbling Well Road, approximately 15
yards from the gateway.

The pathway at this point was scored and disco-
lored, and nearby was found a thin piece of tin and a
few scraps of coloured paper as pasted on tins of
saleable goods.

The distance of the "strike" from the gateway
also the position, would tend to nullify the theory
advanced that the bomb had been thrown over for hurried
disposal. It would now appear to emphasize that this
occurred for intimidation purposes.

One piece of paper was scorched and minute
fragments still adhered to the pavement where the
bomb struck, but no further fragments of bomb splinters
were located.

Police have now been placed on duty on both
the Bubbling Well Road and Chengtu Road walls surround-
ing the grounds.

1938年3月30日上午6时，签署人前往意大利领事馆院内进行进一步搜查，结果在通往静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）的旧入口通道上，距大门约15码处，确定了炸弹落点。

该处通道表面有刮痕且变色，附近发现一片薄铁皮和几片彩色纸屑，如同贴在商品罐头上的标签纸。

“落点”距大门的距离及其位置，使得此前提出的“炸弹是被匆忙扔过墙以作处理”的理论难以成立。目前看来，这更倾向于表明此举旨在恐吓。

其中一张纸被烧焦，仍有微小碎片粘附在炸弹击中的路面上，但未发现其他炸弹破片。

警方现已在环绕该院落的静安寺路和成都路围墙两侧部署执勤警力。

daily newspaper dated April 12th, 1938 in which the thermos
flask was wrapped when thrown. The beggar could not give any
information as to where the flask was thrown from, he merely
stated that he had observed it lying on the road. No persons
were seen decamping nor were any suspicious persons observed
loitering in the vicinity.

Mr. Fletcher, analyst, S.M.C. Health Dept., attended
this station and dismantled the thermos flask and found the
bottle to contain an amber coloured powder which in his opinion
is Arsenic Sulphide and Potassium Chlorate. Between the sides
of the flask casing and the bottle was packed numerous small
pieces of cast iron which appear to be fragments of an old
cooking pot.

The thermos flask bottle is made of a double glass
casing, there being a vacuum between the two. Only the outer
casing was broken by the fall, whilst the inner remained intact,
this presumably being the reason for no explosion.

The thermos flask is of the usual one pint type size,
trade mark "Camel" brand made by the Kuo Kwong (國光) Industrial
Factory.

It is known that this brand of thermos flask can be
purchased at numerous shops and stores in Louza district.

It is worthy of note that this bomb is of a similar
type as the one thrown in the Italian Consulate Grounds on the
29-3-38 and that which was thrown at Yu Ya Ching Road and
Bubbling Well Road intersection on the 30-3-38. The bomb thrown
into the Italian Consulate Grounds was also made with the "Camel"

该热水瓶为常见的一品脱规格，商标为“骆驼”牌，由国光（國光）实业厂制造。

Louza
April 13, 38
Thermos flask presumably to be thrown by an unknown person
on Nanking Road.
P.S. A. Kramer, No.34

Sir,
I beg to report that while on duty at the junction of
Chekiang and Nanking Roads at about 11.15 a.m. 13/4/38, I
observed a Japanese Military M/truck, Khaki colour, bearing a
Japanese military number plate No.33 in arabic figures affixed
to the rear, proceeding East on Nanking Road. The vehicle was
driven by a Japanese soldier, who had a companion also in
uniform alongside him in the driver's cab, while two other
Japanese soldiers were seated on the floor-boards of the truck
with their respective backs resting against the driver's cab.
My attention was drawn to the truck due to the reckless manner in
which the vehicle was being driven, it was overtaking all other
vehicles proceeding in the same direction. Due to the light
traffic signals being against East bound traffic the driver of
the Japanese military truck stopped the vehicle approximately
5 yards East of the Long Zieu, on Nanking Road. In the meantime
I proceeded on my patrol East along Nanking Road towards Chekiang
Road, and came abreast of the truck at the aforementioned
designated place. At about 11.18 a.m. while standing on the
north - east corner of the junction of Nanking and Chekiang
Roads, I observed the same Japanese military truck in motion
proceeding east on Nanking Road, it crossed Chekiang Road and
when the said vehicle was about 5 yards east of the Loong Zieu
Yue ( ), I observed a white coloured object land adjacent
to the rear off-side wheel. The M/truck continued to proceed
in the same direction without stopping. I immediately proceeded
to the place where I had observed the object fall, On arrival
I discovered that the object was a thermos flask and that it

先生，
谨报告，1938年4月13日上午11时15分左右，当我在浙江路与南京路交叉口执勤时，观察到一辆日本军用摩托卡车，卡其色，车尾挂有阿拉伯数字书写的日本军用号牌33号，正沿南京路向东行驶。该车由一名日本士兵驾驶，驾驶室内其身旁坐着一名同样身着制服的同伴，另外两名日本士兵坐在卡车底板上，背靠着驾驶室。由于该车驾驶方式鲁莽，超越所有同向行驶的车辆，引起了我的注意。由于向东行驶的交通信号灯为红灯，这辆日本军用卡车的司机在南京路上龙飞（Long Zieu，音译）以东约5码处停下车。与此同时，我沿南京路向东巡逻，朝浙江路方向行进，在上述指定地点与卡车并行。上午11时18分左右，当我站在南京路与浙江路交叉口的东北角时，我看到同一辆日本军用卡车启动，沿南京路向东行驶，穿过浙江路，当该车行至龙飞月（Loong Zieu Yue，原文不清，括号内为空）以东约5码处时，我观察到一个白色物体落在右后轮旁边。该摩托卡车继续向同一方向行驶，未停车。我立即前往观察到物体掉落的地方，到达后发现该物体是一个热水瓶，并且它

已被一名属于乞丐阶层的中国行人捡起，该行人还持有两份中文《标准日报》（Standard，括号内为空），热水瓶在被投掷时即用此报纸包裹。

在盘问该中国人时，他立即将热水瓶交给我。我询问他是否观察到热水瓶是从何处投掷的，他予以否认，仅称他只看到热水瓶在路上。

我对在该地区遇到的行人进行了进一步询问，但无人能提供任何有用信息。

谨陈述，当我看到白色物体击中路面时，我推测其可能具有爆炸性质，并环顾四周，但未观察到有人逃离，也未发现现场有任何人以可疑方式徘徊。

在现场进行例行询问后，我将热水瓶和报纸包装送往警局，在那里我接到指示将热水瓶放入一桶水中。

先生，

您顺从的仆人，
